header.running_head: 2. Doing Deeds for the Pleasure of Allah...

blocks.text:
mentioned the word Qirat. This Qirat should not be taken as a Qirat of this world; it is the measure of the Qirat of the Hereafter. He also explained that, if reckoned against the Qirat of this world, it is as great and vast as Mount Uhud.
(Ma'ariful Hadith)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ ﵁ يَقُوْلُ: سَمِعْتُ اَبَا الْقَاسِمِ ﷺ يَقُوْلُ: اِنَّ اللهَ قَالَ: يَا عِيْسَي اِنِّيْ بَاعِثٌ مِنْ بَعْدِكَ اُمَّةً اِنْ اَصَابَهُمْ مَا يُحِبُّوْنَ حَمِدُوا اللهَ وَاِنْ اَصَابَهُمْ مَا يَكْرَهُوْنَ احْتَسَبُوْا وَصَبَرُوْا وَلَا حِلْمَ وَلَا عِلْمَ فَقَالَ: يَا رَبِّ كَيْفَ يَكُوْنُ هذَا لَهُمْ وَلَا حِلْمَ وَلَا عِلْمَ؟ قَالَ: اُعْطِيْهِمْ مِنْ حِلْمِيْ وَعِلْمِيْ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الحاكم وقال: هذا حديث صحيح علي شرط البخاري ولم يخرجاه ووافقه الذهبي:١ /٣٤٨
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Darda (RA) narrates that he heard the Prophet ﷺ say, “Allah Ta'ala said to Hazrat Isa (AS), “O Isa, after you I am going to send an Ummah. If they receive what they like (such as health and blessings), they will thank Allah Ta'ala for it. If a trial or hardship they dislike comes to them, they will hope for the reward I have promised for bearing it. Moreover, even though they lack (a gentle nature and soft temperament) forbearance and knowledge, they will hold fast to patience.” Hazrat Isa (AS) asked, “O my Lord, when they have neither forbearance nor knowledge and wisdom, how will they be able to remain patient and hope for the reward?” To this Allah Ta'ala said, “I will give them forbearance from My forbearance, and knowledge and wisdom from My knowledge and wisdom.”
